S1.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
S1.answer:
- **Get Clássica:** Focused on speed. It prints receipts, accepts tap and Pix via QR Code, and has Chip 3G + Wi-Fi. Rental is free at R$ 10,000/month in sales, otherwise R$ 79.90/month. (https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/)
- **Get Smart:** Focused on complete management. It integrates the order with the payment, has Chip 3G with a free data plan + Wi-Fi, and accepts tap and Pix. It costs R$ 129.90/month, deducted from sales. (https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/)
- **Free machine:** Get Smart is free at R$ 60,000/month per machine, versus R$ 10,000 for the Clássica. (https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/termos_e_condicoes_aluguel.pdf)

S4.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
S4.answer:
Yes. To sell with Pix on Get Tap, you need to enable the feature and link a bank account in the Getnet Brasil app. You do this under "Serviços" > "Venda com Pix" > "Habilitar", then choose your bank and follow the on-screen instructions. The linked account is the one that receives the Pix payments.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix-no-get-tap-mais-agilidade-e-eficiencia-das-vendas/

S5.message: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
S5.answer:
Your terminal (serial GS-77A1) is offline. It was last seen on 2026-11-13 at 23:31, and it is on Wi-Fi with a weak signal, which is the most likely cause. Battery is at 42%, and the firmware (4.2.1) is out of date, since 4.3.0 is available.

**Get Smart:** On the home screen, tap "Configurar". Then open "Wi-Fi" to see the available networks and connect, or open "Conexões" to manage Wi-Fi, the 4G chip and Bluetooth, and run a "Teste de Conexão".

**Get Clássica:** Tap Wi-Fi or Suporte, then Habilitar Wi-Fi, then Procurar Redes. Select your network and enter the password if needed. The keypad can enter letters and special characters.

S6.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
S6.answer:
Receivables advance lets you receive credit card sales (lump-sum or installments) before the original scheduled dates, in exchange for a fee. It is not a loan: you get money that is already yours, with no new debt. (https://site.getnet.com.br/quando-vale-a-pena-antecipar-as-suas-vendas-no-cartao/)

In the Getnet Brasil app, you can view available receivables, simulate the advance, and see the net amount before confirming. The fee can affect your margin. (https://site.getnet.com.br/quando-vale-a-pena-antecipar-as-suas-vendas-no-cartao/)

On the Get Smart terminal: Payment > Antecipação > enter the merchant password > select the card brand > check values and simulate > tap "Antecipar" > enter the advance code from the simulation. A receipt is then printed. (https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Manul-GetSmart.pdf)

S9.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
S9.answer:
With Crediário Getnet, you can split a sale into up to 48 installments. The maximum number of installments depends on the customer's issuing bank (e.g., general banks up to 24x, Santander up to 48x), and the customer needs enough available credit limit for the full purchase amount.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Folder_Credirio.pdf

S10.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
S10.answer:
Yes. Getnet's Payment Link lets you send a link to customers via WhatsApp, social networks, email, or any other digital channel, with no card machine or online store needed. The customer clicks the link and pays by credit card, debit, or Pix.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento-getnet/
Also: https://www.getnet.net/en/our-solutions/online-payments
